## Trace Path

What user-facing behavior does this test verify?

## Test Assertion

What observable outcome confirms the behavior works?

## Implementation Scope

**Minimal code to pass the test.** No anticipation of future tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Test describes behavior, not implementation
- [ ] Test uses public interface only
- [ ] Test would survive internal refactor
- [ ] Code is minimal for this test
- [ ] No speculative features added

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Test written and red
- [ ] Implementation passes test
- [ ] Refactor if needed
- [ ] Commit tracer bullet progress
